speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. To begin our evaluation, how long have you had these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or urine color?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. Recently, she has observed the darkening of her urine, which she believes is due to inadequate water intake. She has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis.

Given your 3-week history of fatigue, fever, and abdominal pain, combined with the darkening of your urine (likely bilirubinuria) and recent exposure to potentially contaminated foods at the state fair, I suspect a viral or toxin-mediated liver injury. Do you have any yellowing of your eyes or skin, or do you see itchy spots on your skin?
